BranchBoard.title: BranchBoard
BranchBoard.description: An independent Branch project storing the standard hierarchical JSON tree and persistent view state.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for cross-platform Android and iPad PWA compatibility.

trunkRevealLevel.description: Persisted staircase reveal depth in Trunk View.

root.description: Standard hierarchical JSON root node containing id, parentId, title, notes, resultLog, color, orderIndex, status, isCollapsed, isPinned, isStrikethrough, variants, activeVariantId, and recursive children array.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when project was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VariantSnapshot.title: VariantSnapshot
VariantSnapshot.description: Deep-cloned subtree snapshot stored for a node's State Variant so switching states swaps the node's children cleanly.

ownerNodeId.description: ID of the BranchNode that owns this state.

label.description: Display label of the state (e.g., 狀態 A, 狀態 B).

children.description: Standard hierarchical JSON array of child BranchNode objects for this state.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when snapshot was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when snapshot was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/boards/{boardId}.description: User-scoped multi-project Branch boards holding standard hierarchical JSON trees.

/users/{userId}/boards/{boardId}/snapsho.description: User-scoped subtree snapshots for node States belonging to a project.
